The race seemed to resolve itself quite rapidly into two fierce battles, between O'Gorman, Brown, Keily, Hicks, Lambert and Haslam on the one hand and a close bunch of a dozen, including our own trio, Colin Collis, Eric Gebbett and Len Bishop on the other.

Startling early season sprint form came from Dwain Chambers with young Chris Lambert also causing a few eyes to open. Pride of place must go to Phillips Idowu though - his 16.41 triple jump extended his Club Record by a further 6 cms. - and Mike Jones, who also set a new Belgrave best in the hammer.
